note: Public list prices on the retrieval date. Cached-input discounts are not applied (the runner does not record cache hits), so per-token costs are upper bounds. Reasoning tokens are billed as output.

gemini.source_note: Aggregators citing Google's standard rate; gemini-3.5-flash is no longer shown on aistudio.google.com/docs/pricing (which lists 3.6/3.8 Flash).

verda-nemotron.source_note: Public per-token list price on OpenRouter (also Together AI) for the same open-weight model, used for comparability. Our runs used a dedicated Verda B300 container (USD 13.65/h on-demand, verda.com/pricing), which is billed per hour, not per token.
